scope_selection.basis: User-declared seven cells selected from already published B1a48-cell coverage counts including final coverage. Not selected using predictor scores or final row data.
scope_selection.post_scope_final_status: Existing24 final seeds remain score-held-out for this fixed limited protocol, but are not a wholly new scope-blind confirmation.
scope_selection.claim_limit: Within the existing synthetic controlled fixture mixture and coverage-selected domain. New seed+unseen-onset/layout confirmation must be separately preregistered before claiming transferable facility prediction.

labels.fit_and_primary_evaluation_cohort: Both heads use the SAME valid B_action>=0 cohort, with A_physical and B_action stored separately. This tests whether physical anomaly and qualified confirmation differ conditional on a legal opportunity.
labels.A_all_endpoint_scope: B1a all-endpoint prevalence is descriptive only; do not extrapolate these heads to illegal/no-opportunity endpoints.
labels.retained_event: Original maximal physical-positive run>=15s; eligible if at least one sampled valid B_action=1 at exact completion. Short/raw events secondary.
labels.endpoint: Original30s root grid,30/60/120s exact endpoints and original tick/noise thresholds unchanged.
labels.no_C: No whole-episode utility,oracle,repair or hidden-fault input.

weighting.dedup: Within each split,seed,numeric-process-fingerprint and noise_c choose first manifest condition; duplicate healthy phases removed. Same fingerprint across splits stops.
weighting.hierarchy: Equal seed weight;equal unique physical process within seed;equal two noise versions within process;each condition divides its weight across its valid cohort rows. Zero-valid condition is a gate failure, not silent drop.
weighting.preprocessing: Original float32 base85/completion13 zero padding plus explicit masks. No learned imputation. Weighted mean/std learned on development only;std<1e-8 set1. Append59root onehots and16public-Pod onehots identically to all LR views; categorical0/1 also development-scaled.

features.clock_basis: Onehot of each frozen30s root30..1770 (59);onehot known public pod0..15 (16). Knots not chosen at fault onsets.
features.time_lr_action: All13completion columns EXCEPT bounded_trend_at_completion_c;no measured value/alarm/velocity/power/flow/CVAE channel. Profession and horizon fixed by head.
features.public_lr: All85+13 public columns except cvae_raw.* and history_assimilated.*;same clock/pod bases as time_lr.

candidates.constant: Development weighted empirical frequency with fixed Laplace alpha=beta=1, effective counts rescaled to validN;not recalibrated.
candidates.scalar_definition: Thermal score=max((temperature-65)/20,0):hold uses public temperature_measurement,trend uses original bounded completion trend,nominal uses root nominal,raw/cache each root channel. Nonthermal hold=max((contact-60)/30,0) or indicator(abs(sensor_error)>1);trend/nominal alias professional hold explicitly (no nonexistent nonthermal forecast). Missing yields score0 with missingness reported. No coefficients searched.
candidates.count: 14heads*(time+public)*3 +6thermalheads*(raw+assimilated+both)*3=138; failed fit consumes slot, no rescue hyperparameters.
candidates.objective: Weighted mean binary logloss + lambda/2*squared standardized slope norm;intercept unpenalized. Stream batches of16384;accumulate gradients across all batches per closure before optimizer step. Hard400closure limit;nonfinite/limit failure recorded without new candidate.

calibration.method: p=sigmoid(softplus(z)*score+b);weighted logloss+a^2/2,intercept unpenalized;start a=1,b=0;TorchCPUfloat64LBFGS lr1,history10,max_iter200,max_eval300,tolgrad1e-6,tolchange1e-9,strong_wolfe,threads1. LR raw score=logit. All candidate scores calibrated identically;frequency constant unchanged.
calibration.failure: Record consumes fixed slot;no alternate method;exclude failed candidate before selection.

selection.threshold: Unweighted selection negatives only, strict calibrated score>threshold. threshold=descending_negative_scores[floor(0.01*Nnegative)] (0-based);ties conservatively rejected. Exactlyfixed1%empirical FPR budget.
selection.per_view: Select its L2 by ranking;freeze selected coefficients/scaler/calibrator/threshold/SHA before final open.
selection.primary_full: public_all_lr for thermal,public_lr for electrical/control;no replacing this primary family using final or selection scalar results.
selection.time_comparator: L2-selected time_lr;must be beaten for any device-information claim.
selection.fixed_comparator: Best of constant,professional_hold,bounded_trend,nominal_physical on selection ranking;freeze before final.
selection.final_views: Only each view preselected L2 and each fixed scalar;unselected L2 never scored on final. Final test exactlyonce after receipt.

uncertainty.unit: Independent seed group,all correlated scenarios/phases/noises staytogether. Never bootstrap rows/events as independent.
uncertainty.aggregate: Paired final24seed bootstrap95%percentile,7cell equalweights;resample same seed indices across all model views and cells. Missing eligible-event cells keep undefined with counts;no zero-as-perfect.
uncertainty.limited_bounds: Simultaneous lower quantile0.05/28 for7cells*2gainmetrics*2comparators(time andfixed). Predeclared cells only.

seal.beforefit: Independent protocol review receipt with protocolSHA,source consistency,coverage authority and actualTorch gates required. No final row cache or modelscore allowed.
seal.phases: Prepare development/calibration/selection cache only;fitdevelopment;calibratecalibration;selectthreshold/modelselection;freeze receipt/artifactSHA;then prepare/score final once;raw final arrays andper-row scores stayprivate.
seal.correctness_repair: Preserve failures andversioncode. Afterfinalopens,no refit/calibration/threshold/familychange. Failed final export may be repaired from same frozen predictions;do not rescore newmodel.
